buttons.name: Session
buttons.description: The session agent answers, in its own context.

buttons.name: Blank
buttons.description: A separate run with nothing loaded: only the request and the file.

buttons.name: Repo
buttons.description: A separate run with the repo's and your CLAUDE.md and rules.

buttons.name: Brief
buttons.description: The session agent writes a brief, and a separate run answers from it.

buttons.name: Do it
buttons.description: A separate run with the repo's context that edits files itself, at once. The session will not know.
